Minutes Final
                      Girdwood Trails Committee Regular Meeting
                              Tuesday, Sept 1, 2026 7:00PM
Girdwood Trails Committee meetings are taking place on Teams with in-person attendance at the Girdwood Community
Room, 250 Egloff Rd.


GTC Voting members are defined as any person eighteen (18) years of age or older who has attended one or more Trails Committee
meetings in the last 12 months, and is:
a)      a current resident and/or property owner, business owner or designated representative of a non-profit association; and
b)     who has resided in, owned property in, owned a business located in, or operated as a non-profit association for the preceding
ninety (90) days or longer in Girdwood Valley.
Attendance is verified through a sign-in sheet available at each meeting, or equivalent process.

The Girdwood Trails Committee operates under the Girdwood Public Meetings Standards of Conduct.

Call to Order
Approval of Sept 1 2026 meeting agenda          BB/PC  Assent
Approval of August 4 2026 meeting minutes       PC/BB  Assent

Announcements & Presentations: None
Introductions:  All new/returning attendees are asked to introduce themselves, members attending via phone anonymously, and
members attending jointly via one computer so that attendance is accurate.

Public Comment (3 minutes each): None
Old Business:

     1.  November GTC meeting conflict with general election in the community room Nov 3.
Motion:
GTC moves to hold the Nov 3 meeting virtually via Teams only, due to the Community Room use for election day.
Motion by PC/BB
Motion carries by assent

     2.  Girdwood Iditarod National Historic Trail
        Middle Iditarod Reroute in Holtan Hills Phase 1: No change since the last meeting. GPR and HLB have walked the alignment
       and agree on the general location of the re-route, although it has not been surveyed.

          Iditarod Historic Trail Alliance (IHTA) funded easements on GwINHT: IHTA and MOA have agreement to reimburse for the
        survey and filing of paperwork for easement. Survey is complete, likely the project will be concluded by December, at which
        time IHTA can reimburse.

     3.  Update on Winner Creek Trail Bridge at Glacier Creek (Kyle)
         Project is stalled due to unclear costs of steel and purchasing requirements under MOA Title 7. Still hoping for construction in
        2027, however price of oil and steel are unstable and high. Steel will come from Europe to meet specs of the USFS, who will
         eventually own and maintain the bridge.

     4.  Consider Community Trails Info message for upcoming month to be shared on social media
       Girdwood Trails Marathon Oct 3.
         Let GPR know about  trail issues via email.

     5.  Girdwood Trails Management Plan Revision and Review
        Status of Appendix 1 (maps); Appendix 2 (list and descriptions of trails); Appendix 8 (land management agreements and
        easements)
        Barb will work on Appendix 1 now that the maps are complete and will bring that to GTC at a future meeting.
      No change on other appendices.

     6.  Girdwood Comprehensive Plan RE Parcel 6-011 and Upper Valley Trails
      No change


                   Girdwood Trails Committee Agendas and minutes are available on line: www.muni.org/gtc

7.  Summer trails projects wrap up: See meeting packet
            trail from Chelsea’s crossing to Crow Creek Road is complete, future work will be trail improvement on the slope to Crow
       Creek Road.
       Lower Virgin Creek trail likely study the area in the next week and start work as possible.

New Business:
     8.  GTC Recommendations for entry area to the Holtan Hills neighborhood.
      GTC primary concern is the trail re-route through Holtan Hills. Ideas for projects at the entry may complicate parking and traffic
         patterns and create more infrastructure for the service area to maintain.

     9.  LWCF & RTP Grant application support (LWCF grant application due Oct 31; RTP application due Oct 30)
      LWCF probably most appropriate for some park element now that the Parks Master Plan is complete. LWCF allows for design
         funding.
          Staff recommendation for RTP is crew and materials for work on Middle INHT, Beaver Pond Trail and Athabascan Trail. GTC
           is supportive of continuation of these projects, which supports the overall trail network loop in Girdwood.
Other:
    10. Ongoing Trails Issues for update:
             •   Status of Trails grants
             •   Other Trails Issues
               Girdwood Trails Marathon 10/3.
    11. Monthly LUC/GBOS Meeting Representatives:
    12. Written Reports should be submitted to include in meeting packet

Adjourn 8PM
